links.comparator_used: Recommendation only, explanation, source citation, and explanation plus citation (pooled controls)
links.outcome: Clinician trust in AI-generated oncology recommendations (5-point Likert)
links.effect: Mean trust 3.80 (3.76–3.84) with AFC vs 2.59 recommendation only, 2.84 explanation, 3.01 citation, 3.09 explanation+citation; Cohen's d = 0.94 (95% CI 0.88-1.00; P < .001) vs pooled controls; trust (score ≥4) rose from 26.9% to 66.5% (+39.5 points; NNT 2.53)
links.quote: AFC produced significantly higher trust than all control conditions.
